= Nested callout contexts

----
outer <1> <2>
----
<1> Outer first.
+
--
----
inner <1>
----
<1> Inner first.
* Inner bullet.
--
<2> Outer second.

== Enclosed literal control

----
outer <1> <2>
----
<1> Before compound block.
+
--
* Ordinary enclosed bullet.
<2> Literal enclosed continuation.
--
<2> After compound block.
